title: inph-csf-meta: R pipeline for the meta-analysis of CSF biomarker profiles in idiopathic normal pressure hydrocephalus
description:
Reproducible R pipeline (metafor, mada) and extracted study-level data for the systematic review and meta-analysis Cerebrospinal fluid biomarker profiles of idiopathic normal pressure hydrocephalus compared with healthy controls and Alzheimer's disease.

The pipeline pools standardized mean differences with random-effects models (REML) and 95% prediction intervals, pools diagnostic sensitivity and specificity for iNPH versus Alzheimer's disease, and runs leave-one-out, sensitivity, exploratory subgroup, age meta-regression and small-study analyses. It renders the supplementary figures and tables of the article.

Code: MIT licence. Data (data/) and result tables (output/tables/): CC BY 4.0.
